meta_description: Drip Doctor is your trusted local plumber in Derby. Emergency repairs, installations, and maintenance. Fast response times, fair prices. Call us today.
hero_eyebrow: Emergency Plumber — Fast Response, Fair Prices
hero_subhead: Burst pipe or leaking tap keeping you up at night? We're here fast, with solutions that work and prices that won't shock you.
services_subhead: From emergency callouts to planned installations, we handle everything your home or business needs.

services.title: Emergency Plumbing Repairs
services.desc: Burst pipes, leaks, and blockages sorted fast—usually the same day. We carry common parts on the van to minimise disruption.

services.title: Boiler Repairs & Servicing
services.desc: Annual boiler checks keep your heating running safely and efficiently. Repairs carried out quickly to get you warm again.

services.title: Tap & Radiator Installation
services.desc: Modern taps, radiators, and heating upgrades installed to your exact spec. We remove the old and leave your space clean.

services.title: Bathroom & Kitchen Plumbing
services.desc: Full refit or single fixture installation—we handle water supply, waste pipes, and all connections with precision.

services.title: Pipe Freezing & Thawing
services.desc: Winter freeze-up? We thaw frozen pipes safely without damage, then advise on prevention for next season.

services.title: Drain Cleaning & Unblocking
services.desc: Stubborn blockages cleared using proven techniques. We locate the cause and fix it so it doesn't come back.

about_pullquote: We treat every home like it's our own—honest work, fair pricing, done right first time.
about_para_1: Drip Doctor has been fixing plumbing across Derby for nearly two decades. Started from frustration with cowboys overcharging and taking shortcuts, we built this business on simple rules: arrive on time, diagnose properly, and charge fairly. Our reputation speaks for itself—most of our work now comes from repeat customers and personal recommendations.
about_para_2: We specialise in emergency callouts because we know how stressful a burst pipe or heating failure can be. Whether it's 2am on a Sunday or mid-morning on a Tuesday, we're there. You'll deal with experienced plumbers who get the job done right, not apprentices learning on your dime.
reviews_heading: What Derby Homeowners Say About Us

reviews.text: Had a nightmare leak in the kitchen at 11pm on a Friday. Called Drip Doctor and Mark was here by midnight. Had it sorted within the hour. Charged a fair rate too—no inflated emergency pricing. Brilliant service, will definitely use again.
reviews.author: Claire M.

reviews.text: Needed a new boiler and full heating system overhaul. The lads were professional, explained everything clearly, and finished on time. System's running beautifully and the warranty gives real peace of mind. Can't fault them.
reviews.author: David K.

reviews.text: Frozen pipes in January—thought we were in for a nightmare. Rang Drip Doctor and they came out same day, thawed everything safely, and gave us tips to prevent it happening again. Proper friendly and knowledgeable. Highly recommend.
reviews.author: Sarah P.
